synthesis.paragraph: Today's issue includes 3 papers tagged with "Urban and Freight Transport Logistics," compared to its previous 7-day average of 0.86 per day. The paper "The role of urban built environment in promoting dockless bike-sharing and metro integration: an adaptive catchment area approach" shares 4 references with the 2026-06-14 paper "Beyond station: Rethinking built environment effects on metro-integrated electric bike-sharing from an origin–destination perspective," including "Built environment effects on the integration of dockless bike-sharing and the metro," "Dockless bike-sharing as a feeder mode of metro commute? The role of the feeder-related built environment: Analytical framework and empirical evidence," and "The spatially varying effects of built environment characteristics on the integrated usage of dockless bike-sharing and public transport." Additionally, "An extended integrated TAM–TPB–IDT model for explaining new energy vehicle purchase intentions among China’s Generation Z" shares 3 references with the 2026-06-16 paper "Co-adoption of solar panels and electric vehicles: Evidence from California," which are "On the stability of preferences and attitudes before and after experiencing an electric vehicle," "Advances in consumer electric vehicle adoption research: A review and research agenda," and "Direct experience with battery electric vehicles (BEVs) matters when evaluating vehicle attributes, attitude and purchase intention." Over the last 30 days, the University of Hong Kong has appeared on 10 papers, the Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Tsinghua University have each appeared on 6 papers, and the Chinese Academy of Sciences has appeared on 5 papers.
